messages:
Priya: Quick update, I'm stuck at the airport. Need to hand primary for the 19:00->03:00 window.
Sam: Who's picking up? Tag them here so pager routing is obvious.
Priya: @Marta? Can you take primary from 18:50? I'll shadow until 19:15 and hand over active pages and dashboards.
Marta: I can cover 18:50->02:50. Couple questions before I go primary: is the canary still set for 20:00 UTC, and what's the exact auto-fallback criteria?
Priya: Canary's a go at 20:00. Plan: 10% then ramp to 50% at +10m if metrics look healthy. Auto-fallback if latency_p90 > 800ms or error_rate > 1% sustained over two 5m windows.
Sam: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollout — see "fallback-and-rollback" and the rollback commands.
Marta: Any customer watchlist I should keep an eye on? We had search-embeds flapping last week.
Priya: Watchlist: cust-embeds-23 and cust-search-42. Dashboard group name is "Canary watchlist" in Ops.
incident-bot: Reminder: Primary must ack pager within 5 minutes. Escalation: primary -> secondary after 5m -> oncall-leads after 15m.
Jo: I'm secondary tonight. I'll be reachable — ready to take on if Marta needs a relief break.
Marta: Handoff checklist for me:
Marta: 1) Confirm pager routing and that my device is subscribed.
Marta: 2) Open telemetry: latency, errors, KV-cache metrics.
Marta: 3) Have rollback steps ready and know where logs are.
Priya: Rollback one-liner:
Priya: ```
Priya: ./infra/canary_ctl rollback --deployment canary-2026-03-15 --to stable
Priya: ```
Sam: Note: if KV cache miss rate exceeds 12% for >3m, consider scaling cache nodes. See runbook section "cache-stability".
Marta: Where's the canary log stream? I want it snapped to a pane.
Priya: Logs at https://logs.redwood.internal/canary-2026-03-15 and Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/CANARY
Marta: Opened both. If median latency rises by 250ms over baseline for 10m, I'll pause rollout manually.
Jo: I'll watch error-rate and the pager channel. Priya, if you don't confirm handoff by 19:10, should I take primary?
Priya: Yes — if I haven't confirmed by 19:10, Jo please claim primary and ping me for context. Otherwise plan is Marta primary 18:50 and I shadow until 19:15.
Marta: Preflight done: validated API key rotation and canary config. Nothing blocking.
Sam: Ops note: autoscaler in that cluster can jitter. During canary bump minReplicas to 3 to avoid flapping. Section: "canary->stability knobs" in runbook.
Marta: Patching now: `kubectl patch hpa canary-service -p '{"minReplicas":3}'`
Marta: Patched and monitoring events.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy canary-2026-03-15 at 20:00 UTC. Auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate >= 1.0% or latency_p90 increase >= 800ms.
Priya: Final: Marta primary 18:50-02:50, Jo secondary, Sam infra support. I'll post a brief handoff in #eng-oncall at 18:45 before I step offline.
Marta: I'll post "primary claimed" at 18:50 and subscribe to the watchlist. :thumbsup:
Jo: Standing by. GL.
Priya: Handed off — switching to standby. Ping me if anything urgent before 19:15.
Marta: Primary confirmed. Running smoke checks now.
Sam: Thanks for tidy handoff, all set on infra side.
